title: Geometry - Lesson 3 Practice: Volume of Cubes
description: Practice modeling and calculating cube volume from side length.

questions.question: What is the formula for the volume of a cube with side length s?
questions.explanation: A cube has equal length, width, and height, so V = s × s × s = s³.

questions.question: A cube has side length 3 cm. What is its volume? Enter just the number.
The volume of a cube with side length 5 cm is 25 cm².
questions.explanation: 25 cm² is the area of one face. The volume is 5 × 5 × 5 = 125 cm³.

questions.question: A cube has side length 4 units. What is its volume?
A cube has 9 unit cubes in each layer and 3 layers. What is the total volume in cubic units? Enter just the number.
questions.explanation: 9 cubes per layer × 3 layers = 27 cubic units.

questions.question: Explain why cube volume uses side × side × side instead of side × side.
questions.correctAnswer: Cube volume uses side × side × side because volume measures three dimensions: length, width, and height.
questions.explanation: side × side gives a square face area. Volume needs the third dimension too.

questions.question: A cube has side length 10 cm. What is its volume? Enter just the number.
A cube has side length 6 m. Find the volume and include the correct unit.
questions.explanation: 6 × 6 × 6 = 216. Since the side length is in meters, the volume is 216 m³.
